trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: In June she will finish her thesis already.
trap.right: By June she will have finished her thesis.
trap.why: Português diz “em junho ela termina”. Para prazo, o inglês usa by + will have + particípio.

mcq.q: This time next week, I **___** flying to Lima.
By Friday, they **___** repaired the roof.
Marta **___** have seen him; she was abroad.
The keys are gone. Someone **___** taken them.

fix.wrong: They will have repair the roof.
fix.right: They will have repaired the roof.

fix.wrong: I will have flying to Lima.
fix.right: I will be flying to Lima.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I fly to Lima this time next week.” (will be)
rewrite.answer: This time next week I will be flying to Lima.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “They repair the roof by Friday.” (will have)
rewrite.answer: They will have repaired the roof by Friday.

rewrite.prompt: Dedução: “It’s impossible that she saw him.” (can’t have)
